title: Riverfront Condo | Walk Downtown | Pool + Parking
description:
Experience Nashville from this chic 2BR/1.5BA condo steps from the Cumberland River. Whether you're here for a weekend of honky tonks or a work trip downtown, this well-appointed getaway offers comfort, convenience, and charm—plus a stunning pool will open on 04/01 with river views and complimentary covered parking!

The space
Sleeps up to 6 guests

Bedroom 1: King bed, Smart TV

Bedroom 2: King bed, Smart TV

Living Room: Full-size sofa bed, Smart TV

Bathrooms:
Full Jack & Jill bath with walk-in shower.
Additional half bathroom

Fully Equipped Kitchen:
Keurig coffee maker (coffee & tea provided), toaster, and full cookware for all your meal needs
Private Balcony: Perfect for morning coffee or evening drinks
Dining Area

Amenities
High-speed WiFi
Smart TVs in every room
Washer & Dryer Facilities 
Central air conditioning & heating
Pet-friendly
On-site pool open on 4/1, overlooking the Cumberland River
Covered, complimentary parking adjacent to the unit

Location Highlights:

Located in a secure building, with free & covered parking just:

-2 min walk to Nashville Sounds Stadium
-10 min walk to Broadway & Honky Tonks
-Short stroll to Downtown Nashville Nissan Stadium, Ryman Auditorium, Farmers Market & TPAC
Steps from the Greenway trails and 5th Ave Arts District

Easy Uber/Lyft access to all of Nashville

Perfect For
-Families or groups
-Business travelers needing downtown access
-Pet owners

Anyone looking for a comfortable, stylish home base near all the action!

Guest access
You will receive check-in instructions with a code (Unique code for each guest, and is only active during your reservation times for your security).
